title: Meta-Ctrl: Guaranteed Plan Generation by Decoupling Syntactic and Semantic Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2608.22149v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLMs generate fluent plans for robots but routinely violate the syntactic and se8mantic constraints they must satisfy to execute, and existing remedies trade formal guarantees against plan quality: soft methods (affordance scoring, grounded decoding) give no guarantee, while symbolic planners (LLM+P) discard the LM's commonsense. We propose \textbf{Meta-Ctrl}, a constrained-decoding framework that guarantees the encoded constraints while preserving the base LM's plan quality. Meta-Ctrl introduces \emph{meta-tokens}---a compact vocabulary of grounded actions---enforcing syntax at the token level and semantics (preconditions, goals, ordering) at the action level, an exact factorization that cuts the memory of constrained decoding from over 107TB to under 2GB. With it, a small open-weight LM becomes competitive where it otherwise sits at the bottom of the leaderboard: on WAH-NL under the LoTa-Bench protocol it reaches the highest reported

translated_title: Meta-Ctrl：通过解耦句法与语义约束实现保证性计划生成
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能为机器人生成流畅的计划，但常常违反执行时必须满足的句法和语义约束，现有的补救措施在形式保证与计划质量之间权衡：软方法（如可负担性评分、接地解码）不提供保证，而符号规划器（如LLM+P）则丢弃了语言模型的常识。我们提出\textbf{Meta-Ctrl}，一个约束解码框架，在保留基础语言模型计划质量的同时保证编码约束。Meta-Ctrl引入\textit{元标记}——一种紧凑的接地动作词汇表——在标记级别强制执行句法，在动作级别强制执行语义（前提条件、目标、顺序），这种精确分解将约束解码的内存从超过107TB降至2GB以下。借助它，一个小的开放权重语言模型在原本排名垫底的情况下变得具有竞争力：在LoTa-Bench协议下的WAH-NL上，它达到了迄今报告的最高成绩。
tldr: Meta-Ctrl通过引入元标记解耦句法与语义约束，实现了约束解码的高效保证，使小模型在机器人计划生成任务中达到顶尖性能。
en_tdlr: Meta-Ctrl decouples syntactic and semantic constraints via meta-tokens, enabling efficient guaranteed decoding that elevates small models to top-tier performance in robot plan generation.
